messages:
maya: Quick sync: experiments show probe-led hedging for budget-limited tenants creates noisy cross-region traffic. Want a compact policy: probe_quota + exponential backoff + minimal probe_hint API.

alex: Current problem: budget_penalty is applied to route_score and probes still fire. Probes need a separate gate.

ben: proposal: per-tenant-region probe_quota (tokens/min), refill rate, and backoff_ttl that doubles on repeated failures. Keep quotas small for low-tier tenants.

sophia: telemetry: emit probe_quota_used, probes_suppressed, probe_backoff_count. Alert if suppressed_probes for high-traffic tenant > 5m. Also plan a weekly "full-sweep" job that ignores quotas to catch silent regressions.

jordan: ops guardrail: global cluster_probe_budget. If total probes exceed budget, enable emergency global backoff and page SRE. Enterprise tenants get higher defaults.

lee: API boundary: policy-engine returns probe_hint = "allowed, remaining_quota, backoff_ttl". Probe-manager enforces. Keep probe_hint flat and stable across schema versions.

maya: storage note: keep quota state in local route-manager memory with periodic checkpoint to metadata-store for HA; avoid DB on hot path.

alex: serialization: probe_hint must be serializable and policy schema must bump when introducing fields. No per-request randomness in probe decisions.

ben: rollout: unit tests + probe-manager sim, staging canary 1% -> 5% -> 20%, region-limited. Exclude enterprise tier initially.

sophia: runbook: if tail latency rises after deploy: 1) toggle off quota enforcement, 2) revert policy config, 3) run full-sweep to warm caches. Add a dashboard tile for suppressed vs fired probes.

jordan: +1. Also add a circuit-breaker metric so we can auto-throttle probes if backend errors spike.

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary window suggested 2026-04-07 02:00-06:00 UTC. Remember to bump policy config_version.

maya: I'll draft RFC follow-up with semantics, DSL sketch, API sample, telemetry, rollout plan, and runbook. Ping this thread when PR is up.

lee: will review the API and HA checkpointing section.

ben: thumbs-up.

maya: closing — PR in ~2h. Thanks all.
